mechanism: CONTROL C1 (task-zone-split, 2026-09-05): the FULL spatial repair of oracle_zone_unwedge.json AND THEN clear_restriction_zones!. Isolates the zone-as-RVO-obstacle from the repair itself: z1/z3 freeze after the repair even though zone_blockage reports n_blocked=0, but that measures GOALS, not deflected paths. Completes here => the surviving zone deflects navigation into the DeliveryBot(6) livelock. Freezes here => the translation and/or the sched re-solve is what wedges it. MEASURING INSTRUMENT, NOT A REPAIR - it deletes the OOD event.
impl_code:
function OracleZoneTransDel!(env)
    zk = [k for (k, _) in active_restriction_zones()]
    isempty(zk) && return (; status = :no_zone)
    st = restage_all_blocked!(env; zone_keys = zk, resume = true, verbose = true)
    fin = st.status; stage = :restage
    if st.status !== :restaged_all
        tw = translate_whole_build!(env; zone_keys = zk, resume = true, verbose = true)
        fin = tw.status; stage = :translate
    end
    clear_restriction_zones!()
    return (; status = fin, stage = stage, n_zones = length(zk), cleared = true)
end
